done_when: Forge's own CI workflows and the forge.yml Forge ships to client repos cancel an in-progress or queued run for the same pull request and workflow when a newer commit is pushed, grouped so the pull_request tests and pull_request_target pr-check jobs never cancel each other and default-branch runs are never cancelled; a workflow test checks the setting for a new repo and for one adopted on an earlier release after sync
why: Every push to a pull request queues a full CI run while the run for the commit it replaced keeps going, so GitHub's run queue backs up (24 queued, 2 running on 2026-10-08; 20 were for superseded commits) and every close waits longer
